fusions.name: Taut Loop
fusions.desc: Loops a thread round an enemy up to 3 tiles away and tugs, dealing 4 damage, up to 1.2 times as much at full reach, with a 30% chance to leave it [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Wringing Clasp
fusions.desc: Clamps down for 26 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health, leaving the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Hauled Tether
fusions.desc: Reels up to 4 enemies within 6 tiles onto you along a thread for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Tightened Stitch
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 5% more damage per stack (24% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
